page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using hypervisor virtualization. Powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8369B CPU running at 2.7 GHz, it provides 4 vCPUs across 2 physical cores with Hyper-Threading enabled. The system features 32.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high RAM-to-vCPU ratio of 8.0 GB per core. Its CPU cache structure includes 48 KB of L1d, 1 MB of L2, and 48 MB of L3 cache, supporting hardware flags such as AVX-512 VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA-NI encryption accelerators. The instance includes 3 Gbps of baseline network bandwidth, does not come with local storage, and includes zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark evaluation highlights moderate single-threaded performance alongside constrained multi-threaded execution and memory bandwidth throughput. Single-core tests such as stress-ng (1858.18) and gzip compression (27.56 GB/sec) fall into average performance tiers, complemented by an average PassMark memory score of 2387.77. However, multi-core benchmarks show limitations, with a multi-core stress-ng score of 3853.92 and a PassMark CPU score of 5887.68 landing in the bottom quartile. Memory bandwidth tests demonstrate 30.29 GB/sec read and 25.91 GB/sec write throughput for uncached large blocks, while bzip3 multi-threaded decompression scored in the bottom 10 percent.

From a resource density and cost efficiency perspective, the ecs.r7.xlarge delivers substantial memory capacity per vCPU, making it suitable for memory-intensive workloads that do not demand extreme parallel compute power. Performance in static web serving (6.41 GB/sec) and light LLM text generation (103.36 tokens/sec) remains solid. However, weak database operation results (2082.38 PassMark DB ops) and modest Redis throughput (3.99 million SET ops/sec) point to potential bottlenecks for heavy concurrent database tasks. Key target applications include web serving, in-memory caching buffers, and general memory-optimized enterprise services requiring dedicated vCPUs with high RAM capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r7.xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance powered by a dedicated 2.7 GHz Intel Xeon 8369B processor featuring 4 vCPUs (2 physical cores) and 32.0 GB of memory. Built on x86_64 architecture, it includes AVX-512 VNNI and cryptographic instruction extensions, supported by 48 MB of L3 cache and a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps without local storage. Performance benchmarks display average single-core CPU throughput and memory scores alongside weak multi-core scaling and memory bandwidth metrics. Web serving achieves 6.41 GB/sec throughput, while small model LLM text generation reaches 103.36 tokens/sec. The instance provides high memory density per vCPU, making it best suited for memory-intensive applications, caching layers, and web application backends that do not require high concurrent multi-core compute capability.
